description: This file defines utility functions for managing and manipulating promises within the GuzzleHttp Promise library, including task queue management, promise inspection, combination, and resolution.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for promise management, including queue handling, task execution, inspection, and aggregation.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Returns the global task queue used for promise resolution; can assign a new queue if provided.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Adds a function to run in the task queue; returns a promise that resolves or rejects based on the task's execution.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously inspects a promise, returning its state, value, or rejection reason.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects multiple promises, returning an array of their state inspection results.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on multiple promises and returns their fulfilled values; throws on any rejection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills when all input promises are fulfilled, or rejects if any are rejected.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with a specified number of fulfilled promises among the inputs, or rejects if not enough fulfill.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with the first fulfilled value among the inputs.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with an array of inspection states for all input promises, regardless of rejection or fulfillment.
